question: By what cause and with what title is the thunderbolt-holder established?
premises: The thunderbolt-holder arises by the grace of Mahākālī.
inference: Mahākālī’s grace confers the status and name of Īśvara upon the thunderbolt-holder.
plain_english: By the grace of Mahākālī, the thunderbolt-holder became known as Īśvara.
